title: Grateful Dead Live at Rosemont Horizon on 1981-12-06
source: Recorded by the late George "Fingers" Bethke; FOB, Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>cassette>Sony TCD5M; first gen. cassettes>Nakamichi CD1, azimuth adjusted>Korg MR1000 (1 bit 5.6MHz); 24/96 with Korg Audiogate; 16/44.1 by Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).  Transfer by Dave Cohen February 2011

ai_review.summary: Good-quality recording of a raw, no‑frills Dead show highlighted by a standout China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this tape four stars, calling it the best copy they have of a solid performance from one of their favorite years. They appreciate the unpolished, "raw nasty" band sound and single out China Cat Sunflower as a highlight, noting the recording sounds clean to their ears.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review praises both the performance and the audio quality; limited data gives moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes it as the best copy they own and says it sounds good to their ears, implying clear and well‑balanced sound despite no explicit source details.
